Use case: illustration-story. Edit our ORIGINAL Moru animation art into a higher-quality 12-frame animation atlas. Image 1 is the approved character identity, not a source of lettering or app symbols. Make exactly FOUR columns by SIX rows of equal square cells, transparent alpha PNG, intended 1536x2304. TOP THREE ROWS are animation A (12 sequential frames), BOTTOM THREE ROWS animation B (12 frames). Each animation reads left to right. Every cell contains the same Moru body at exactly the same SCALE and grounded anchor; no growth/shrink between poses. Frame1 and12 of each gesture are identical neutral rest. Frames2-11 are genuinely incremental in-between poses with clear anticipation, action, follow-through and gentle settle, not duplicate stills. Aim for masterful cute 1990s hand-crafted pixel-animation feel with smooth pose progression and extremely clear silhouettes. Moru: low round stone-gray seal, ivory cheeks/belly, navy paired vertical eyes, small DIAMOND nose (not plus), two short navy whiskers each cheek, indigo front FLIPPERS (not hands), curled forked tail on LEFT with ivory notch. NO human anatomy, clothes or insects. Flat pixel clusters and deliberate stepped edges, very restricted colors navy #171923, stone #d6d3c9, ivory #fff1d7, indigo #6d73d2 and muted indigo #50569c. No dithering, noise, grain, gradients, glow, shadows, blue eye edges, text, labels, guides or extra symbols. Keep both eyes equally dark and symmetrical except paired intentional blinks. Props when needed must be small on the floor directly in front BETWEEN flippers, within Moru's existing horizontal silhouette; never extend outside the cell or push Moru smaller. Keep body proportions and face placement invariant while moving flippers, tail or gaze. Mild squash is allowed only for hop/landing. This is a production pixel sprite atlas, no presentation board.
